svg.title: Helix Hold drone role silhouettes
svg.desc: Actual production mesh projections for Pierce, Sweep, Stasis, Halo and Pin. Passive fields have radial bodies with no forward barrel.

g.text: Actual drone geometry · oblique and front projections · equal scale across roles
Passive fields surround their drone. Pin flashes only when a shot hits. Pierce and Sweep keep their aimed beams.
CPU geometry illustration, not a browser screenshot or proof of in-game readability. Halo and Pin are the Crown workshop experiment.
